name: Kongolo Bridge
facts: Kongolo Bridge, a cantilever rail‑road marvel, first opened in 1939, spanning 440 meters of the Lualaba River with a 70‑meter main span that carries both a single 5‑meter lane and dual‑gauge rails.
In 1968, Mobutu’s regime commissioned German engineer Erich F. Weigl to reconstruct the bridge, preserving its original cantilever design while upgrading its structural integrity for modern traffic.
The bridge’s single 5‑meter lane uniquely accommodates both vehicular traffic and dual‑gauge railway lines, a rare feature that underscores its dual-purpose engineering.
